background.coverCroppedHint: Covers display the square you cropped; turn off to show the full image. The original is always kept.

flow.useAsBackground: Use flow as the Now-Playing background
flow.sourceHint: “Follow cover” uses the current cover's palette and falls back to your custom colors when there's no cover.
flow.customColorsHint: Used for “Custom”, and as the fallback when a cover has no usable colors.
flow.enableHint: Adds a flowing-light layer above the background image/video and below the visualizer — they stack, not replace.
flow.showOnImmersiveVideoTracks: Show flow on video tracks while immersive
flow.videoTracksHint: Normal video playback shows flow by default; immersive video hides it by default so the video can stay clean.

visualizer.title: Visualizer
visualizer.modeOffDescription: Turn off Now Playing visual effects.
visualizer.modeBackgroundDescription: Show the live visualizer in the Now Playing background.
visualizer.modeIdleOnlyDescription: After a quiet moment, hide the panels and leave lyrics with the background or visualizer.
visualizer.modeLyricsOnlyDescription: After a quiet moment, make the window transparent and show only lyrics.
visualizer.openSettingsHint: Right-click or long-press to open settings
visualizer.previewOnlyHint: Temporarily hides the cover, controls, queue, and dock so full-screen effects are easier to judge.
visualizer.backgroundPreviewHint: These preview toggles reset when the panel closes, so the player returns to its normal layers.
visualizer.useCoverColorHint: When the current track has cover art, its dominant color takes priority over the theme accent.
visualizer.videoTracksHint: Normal video playback shows the background visualizer by default.
visualizer.immersiveVideoTracks: Show visualizer on video tracks while immersive
visualizer.immersiveVideoTracksHint: Immersive video playback hides the visualizer by default so the video remains unobstructed.
visualizer.asBackgroundHint: Overlays the live visualizer above the background image or slideshow (uses more power).

help.style: Chooses the visualizer look. Each style remembers its own tuning, so you can switch back without losing the feel you set.
help.previewOnly: Temporarily hides player chrome while this panel is open, so you can judge the effect without changing saved settings.
help.useCoverColor: Lets the current cover art guide the visualizer color. Turn it off when you want the theme accent to stay consistent.
help.videoTracks: Controls whether video tracks keep the live background visualizer during normal playback.
help.immersiveVideoTracks: Controls whether video tracks keep the live background visualizer after Now Playing enters its immersive idle state.
help.asBackground: Places the live visualizer behind Now Playing content. It looks more immersive and may use more power.
help.blendMode: Controls how the background visualizer mixes with the image below it. Try softer modes for readability and brighter modes for a more luminous look.
help.idleOnly: Hides the player UI after a few quiet seconds on Now Playing, leaving the background visualizer in focus.
help.memoryOverlay: Shows your saved memories while the player UI is hidden, so notes and timestamped moments can surface without leaving immersive mode.
help.fftSize: Controls how much audio detail the visualizer listens to. Higher can feel more precise but may react a little slower.
help.smoothing: Controls how quickly the motion settles. Higher feels calmer and smoother; lower reacts faster to beats.
help.minDecibels: Sets the quietest sound level the visualizer treats as visible. Lower picks up more quiet details; higher ignores background noise.
help.maxDecibels: Sets the loud level where motion reaches full strength. Lower makes the visualizer hit harder sooner; higher leaves more headroom.
help.intensity: Controls how strongly the music drives the visual. Higher moves more; lower stays restrained.
help.motion: Controls animation speed. Higher feels more energetic; lower feels slower and calmer.
help.density: Controls how many bars, rays, or points are drawn. Higher looks richer; lower is cleaner and lighter.
help.spread: Controls how far the visual opens out from the center. Higher fills more space; lower stays compact.
help.mirror: Controls reflection strength. Higher shows more reflection; lower keeps the main shape clearer.
help.backgroundOpacity: Controls how visible the visualizer layer is over the background.
help.backgroundDim: Adds darkness over the visualizer so covers, lyrics, and controls stay readable.

visualizer.idleOnlyHint: On Now Playing, fade out the cover, controls, queue, header, and dock after a few idle seconds so only the background visualizer remains.
visualizer.memoryOverlayHint: When only the background and spectrum remain, surface your memories one at a time as a top popover — timestamp-pinned ones at their moment, the rest filling the quiet gaps.

settings.liveRequestsRequirePrefixHint: Only chat messages that start with a prefix above are treated as song requests. Off: every message is a request.
settings.liveRequestsOnlineFallback: Try online sources on low confidence

settings.liveRequestsRequireApprovalHint: Keeps live chat from interrupting playback automatically.

settings.liveRequestsMappingDesc: Map the incoming request body to a query

settings.crossfadeHint: Smoothly fade the music when switching songs and when pausing or resuming, instead of cutting abruptly. On by default.
settings.listeningEmpty: No listening data in this range.
settings.listeningLocalFirstHint: Listening data is stored locally. Cloud sync only uploads it when you publish to your own drive.
settings.listeningDeviceLinkHint: Complete listening history, rankings, and sync status live in Listening stats.
settings.autoFetchLyricsHint: Look up time-synced lyrics for uploads and streamed songs. This sends the track title and artist to the selected lyrics source.
settings.lyricsMatchToastsHint: Show a brief toast while matching lyrics and when it finishes. Turn off for silent matching.
settings.smoothScrollHint: Off by default. Turn it on to glide the mouse wheel through long lists, queues, and album pages.
settings.smoothScrollHintMac: Off by default. Turn it on to glide the mouse wheel through long lists, queues, and album pages.
settings.lyricsSourceHint: Auto tries the best sources in order. NetEase Cloud Music has a large CJK catalogue; NetEase songs use exact song-id matching when available.
settings.appIconHint: Changes the browser tab icon and the running dock / taskbar icon. The installed icon updates on the next app update.
settings.appIconBrowserHint: Changes the browser tab icon. Desktop dock / taskbar icons update in the Electron app.
settings.albumCoverHint: Applies to song, set, and album square covers. Artist avatars stay circular.
settings.electronWindowHint: Applies to the frameless Electron window. The border is drawn above the background layer so visual effects won't dim it.
settings.electronWindowUnavailable: Available in the Electron desktop app.

settings.djCapabilitiesHint: These chips show the tool calls the DJ can use. Select one to see what it can do and when it is available.
settings.llmNoEnabled: No providers with a key yet
settings.cloudNote: MUZERO stays local-first for storage; only music rendering calls this cloud API, with your key. The request/response mapping lives in src/musicgen/cloud-provider.ts — adjust it for your chosen provider.
settings.localNote: MUZERO is local-first: tracks, audio, and these settings live in your browser's IndexedDB on this device. API keys are stored locally and sent only to the provider you choose — never to us.
settings.costHint: ≈ {{song}} per song · continuous ≈ {{hourly}}/hr (one song every ~3 min)
settings.costUnknown: Cost depends on your provider's pricing.
settings.modelHint: auto = latest model; or enter a specific version id.
settings.deviceAvatarHint: Upload a square avatar. When profile publishing is on, Sync uploads it to writable owner/trusted R2 drives.
settings.deviceProfilePublish: Publish this device profile when syncing
settings.deviceProfilePublishHint: Only owner/trusted writable drives can receive this name, generated avatar seed, and uploaded avatar.
settings.cloudPreviewEmpty: No manifest has been published yet. Run Sync now to publish this drive.
settings.cloudReadOnlyNote: Public links import as read-only stream sets. Media stays remote until cached.
settings.cloudAutoSyncPaused: Auto sync is paused. Run Sync now or change this setting to resume.
settings.cloudCorsHint: Use this on the bucket when running MUZERO in a browser.
settings.cloudMultiWriterHint: Multiple devices can sync to this drive. Sync now is bidirectional: it first pulls other devices' edits into your sets (new tracks, removals, renames), then publishes the merged result — both sides' additions are kept, removals propagate safely, and conflicting writes re-merge and retry automatically.
settings.cloudPresenceHint: Optional. Only owner/trusted writable drives may publish this device's current track.
settings.cloudPresenceCost: Writes are throttled to track/state changes and at most one heartbeat per minute.
settings.cloudOwnerSimplifiedHint: Paste your R2 S3 endpoint, access key, secret, and public bucket URL. MUZERO uses the whole bucket — no prefix needed.
settings.cloudTrustedSetupHint: After this device is configured, copy a trusted-device setup link from its drive card and paste it on another device. The link contains write credentials, so only send it to your own trusted devices.
settings.cloudOwnerNoBuckets: No buckets found for these credentials.
settings.cloudOwnerValidated: Owner drive validated and saved locally.
settings.addDriveDesc: Connect your own Cloudflare R2 bucket, or paste a setup/share link from another device.
settings.addDriveFolderHint: Use only this path inside the bucket. Leave empty to use the whole bucket.
settings.addDriveSharedHint: Paste a public read-only link, or a trusted-device setup link copied from your own drive card.
settings.addDriveBucketSectionHint: Create or pick a bucket in Cloudflare R2 first, then enter its S3 endpoint (or account ID) and bucket name.
settings.addDriveWriteSectionHint: After creating S3-compatible keys from an R2 API token, enter the Access Key ID and Secret Access Key. They stay local to this device.
settings.addDrivePublicSectionHint: This public bucket URL is used for manifest/media reads in browsers and on other devices. Public read-only imports can also use Add from link.
settings.addDriveValidateOptionalHint: Validation is optional; you can continue and save directly.
settings.addDriveGuidePublicReadBody: Public playback and import only need the public bucket URL or manifest URL plus bucket CORS. They do not need Access Key ID or Secret Access Key.
settings.addDriveGuideCorsBody: Add the recommended MUZERO CORS JSON to the bucket so browser fetch, audio playback, and preview checks can read objects.
settings.addDriveGuideWriteBody: Owner/trusted bidirectional sync needs R2 S3 API credentials. Cloudflare creates them from an R2 API token, then MUZERO stores the Access Key ID and Secret Access Key locally.
settings.addDriveGuideSharedBody: Use a public manifest link for read-only import, or a trusted-device setup link copied from your own drive card for write sync on another device.
settings.addDriveGuideNameBody: This name is local to this device, so you can rename the same drive differently on each device.
settings.addDriveGuideAutoSyncBody: By default MUZERO syncs immediately after adding and keeps future local changes on automatic sync. You can switch to manual on the drive card.
settings.addDriveSyncAfterAddHint: Publish this device to the drive immediately after saving.
settings.addDriveAutoSyncAfterChangesHint: Future local edits sync after a short debounce. You can change this on the drive card.
settings.perfHudHint: Floating FPS / memory / blob-URL monitor in the bottom-left corner. Used for performance baselining; off by default.
settings.traceHint: Local playback diagnostics for the current app session. Reproduce the issue, then copy this log.
settings.traceReproEmpty: No user actions in this view.

settings.importFoldersDesc: Remembered local folders are re-scanned on launch; new files are added automatically.

settings.importFolderRecursiveHint: When off, MUZERO only scans files directly inside this folder.
settings.importFoldersResetBody: This removes remembered folder links and tracks imported from those folders in MUZERO. Files on disk are not deleted, so you can import them again.

settings.chatLimitsHint: Higher reply tokens avoid cut-off answers; a bigger context window lets long chats run before compressing. Tune to your model.
settings.aiGenHint: Off by default. Generation uses a paid cloud API (BYOK). When on, the DJ can generate songs; search & ingest from streaming sources stays free either way.
